name: donna
description: Donna — a local-first personal assistant for macOS
author: ALJ

scripts.icon: rm -rf /tmp/Donna.iconset && mkdir -p /tmp/Donna.iconset && for s in 16 32 128 256 512; do sips -z $s $s assets/appicon.png --out /tmp/Donna.iconset/icon_${s}x${s}.png >/dev/null; d=$((s*2)); sips -z $d $d assets/appicon.png --out /tmp/Donna.iconset/icon_${s}x${s}@2x.png >/dev/null; done && mkdir -p assets/build && iconutil -c icns /tmp/Donna.iconset -o assets/build/donna.icns

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Donna uses the microphone for voice input, only when you ask.
extendInfo.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Donna reads your calendar to plan your day, on this Mac only.
extendInfo.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Donna reads your calendar to plan your day, on this Mac only.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Donna reads app and window info for the optional local tracker.
